title: When You Wake Up Tired, Wait on the Lord 🌅 | Morning Prayer for Strength (Isaiah 40:31)
description:
Bring your tired heart to God this morning: wait on the Lord, receive new strength from KJV Scripture, and take one practical step for today.

Subscribe and pray with us every morning and every night.

Chapters
0:00 Opening prayer
13:27 Declaration for today
14:27 One thing to do today
15:01 Blessing
